title: Quick Zesty Jamaican Goats Cheese Tacos
description: A fast and flavorful Jamaican-inspired twist on traditional tacos, featuring creamy goats cheese and a hint of spice.
instructions: Heat a molcajete over medium-high heat.
In a small bowl, mix together flour and jerk seasoning.
Toss the red onion and red bell pepper in the flour mixture until well coated.
Add olive oil to the molcajete and saut0 the onion and pepper mixture until caramelized.
Add garlic powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add goats cheese and stir until melted and smooth.
Deglaze with red wine vinegar and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in honey and season with salt to taste.
Warm tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the cheese mixture onto a tortilla and topping with chopped cilantro.
